ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - LocalPotato Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the LocalPotato POC based on basic PE metadata information and default CLI examples

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\LocalPotato\\\.exe$") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\-i\\ C\\:\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-o\\ Windows\\\\.*")) OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=E1742EE971D6549E8D4D81115F88F1FC.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=DD82066EFBA94D7556EF582F247C8BB5.*")))
